at: He was seven. He woke in the dark
alt: A seven-year-old stops at his parents’ door in the dark, a voice he doesn’t know behind it.
scene: BIRD'S-EYE exposition down a dark timber corridor of a small Silla house at night: a small boy of seven, barefoot in a white sleeping robe, frozen mid-step at a closed plank door, a thin band of warm lamplight under the door. Behind the door, only suggested, two adult shadows on the paper, close together. Crushed black, one lamp key. Adult-proportioned parents if any edge of them shows; the child is a real small child, never chibi. DEPTH: a dark beam at the lens, the boy sharp, the far end of the corridor in haze.

at: …I heard you once. Through the door.
alt: From high above, two small figures on the bluff over the black river.
scene: BIRD'S-EYE exposition, very high: a grass bluff over a wide black river at night, two tiny figures seated near the edge, one older man and one younger, a sleeve across the younger man's shoulders. Far below, paper lotus lamps drifting one by one on the black water. Vast empty night sky, one moon break. The figures are small in a huge place. Adult proportions, never chibi. DEPTH: grass blades at the lens, the two sharp, the river dissolving.

at: Three days later six old men vote
alt: Bird’s-eye of the Harmony Council: six old men in a ring, a boy writing the new king’s name.
scene: BIRD'S-EYE straight down into a dark Silla council hall: six old men in court robes seated in a ring on cushions, one empty king's mat at the head; at a low desk a boy of about eleven with a brush, writing. One oil lamp in the centre of the ring, long shadows. No readable writing. Adult proportions, never chibi. DEPTH: a roof beam dark at the top edge, the ring sharp, the corners of the hall falling to black.

at: Before dawn forty guards knock three times
alt: Before dawn, guards massed at a barred palace door while the party light still leaks through.
scene: WIDE EXPOSITION, low and long: the Moon Palace gate before dawn, a barred timber door, warm feast-light leaking through the cracks; a mass of guards in dark lamellar filling the yard, one of them with his fist raised to knock. Blue pre-dawn sky, one hard warm key from inside the door. Tiny human scale, never a catalogue of faces. Adult proportions. DEPTH: a spear shaft dark at the lens, the door sharp, the palace roofs in mist.

alt: In the walled house, the deposed king dies with a cup still in his hand.
scene: INTIMATE medium shot, low: a bare walled room in autumn, Jinji slumped in a chair, a wine cup loose in his hand, eyes half closed, no crown, plain robe. In the doorway, a woman in undyed white, his mother, seen from behind, one hand on the frame, not entering. Cold daylight from a high window, one hard shaft, long shadow. Adult proportions, never chibi. DEPTH: the cup sharp in the foreground, his face sharp, the doorway soft.

at: The first night, once the servants are asleep
alt: One lamp in an empty room: the king has sent for the new boy, and nobody else is there.
scene: WIDE EXPOSITION of a small palace room at night, almost empty: one oil lamp on the floor between two people sitting on the bare boards, King Jinpyung and a thin young man, facing each other, a great deal of dark floor around them. The lamp is the only light, raking up into both faces. Adult proportions, never chibi. DEPTH: the lamp flame sharp close to the lens, the two sharp, the walls falling into umber black.

at: A palace servant who talks to the air
alt: Close on a servant’s shoes by the kitchen door, filled with salt, and a bowl set down like a dog’s.
scene: EXTREME CLOSE-UP, low to the ground: a pair of straw shoes on packed earth beside a kitchen door, white salt heaped inside them, a wooden bowl of cold rice set on the ground like a dog's bowl. In the soft background a thin young man in a servant's coat walking past, not looking down. Hard daylight, one shadow. Adult proportions, never chibi. No text. DEPTH: salt crystals sharp, the shoes sharp, the figure dissolving.

at: Four years later, the same table.
alt: Four years later, bird’s-eye on the same supper: the fish, the soup, the two of them.
scene: BIRD'S-EYE straight down onto a low supper table in the king's rooms: a whole fish, a soup bowl, two cups; King Jinpyung on one side, Yongsu the servant on the other, four years older, both looking at the fish and not at each other. One lamp at the edge of the table. Adult proportions, never chibi. DEPTH: the lamp sharp, the dishes sharp, the room dark at the corners.

at: That night Chunmyung cries into her pillow
alt: Close on Chunmyung crying into her pillow, efficient even in that.
scene: EXTREME CLOSE-UP, low beside the pillow: Chunmyung face pressed into a silk pillow, eyes wet, one fist in the cloth, crying with her shoulders tight, a single lamp behind her. Simple jade hairpin, no crown. Adult proportions, never chibi. One hard lamp key, crushed black. DEPTH: a fold of the pillow sharp at the lens, her face sharp, the room gone.

at: He was eleven, and there were five of them
alt: High over the stable yard: five boys have Chunchu down in the slush, and his father keeps singing by the stream.
scene: HIGH ANGLE, wide exposition of a palace stable yard in winter slush: five boys in a knot over one smaller boy on the ground behind the stables; thirty paces away, small, a man kneeling at the stream bank singing to a stone, not turning around. Flat winter light, one pale sun break, long grey shadows. Adult and boy proportions realistic, never chibi. DEPTH: a stable post dark at the lens, the fight sharp, the singer small in the haze.

alt: Bird’s-eye of the Hwangnyong Temple yard, timber rising into a nine-storey tower.
scene: BIRD'S-EYE exposition of the Hwangnyong Temple yard in daylight: stacks of raw timber, ropes, a wooden tower skeleton rising several storeys inside the temple walls, giwa roofs of the temple halls around it, tiny workers. One man with a tally board standing apart, Yongsu, grey-haired, looking up. Pale high-key sky, one sun shaft on the tower. Adult proportions, never chibi. No readable text. DEPTH: a roof tile edge at the lens, the tower sharp, the far halls in haze.

alt: Close on a boy’s brush writing the one word the record will keep, while the hall argues behind him.
scene: EXTREME CLOSE-UP on a boy's hand and a brush laying ink on a scroll, the marks illegible scribbles, one lamp raking the paper. Behind, thrown completely out of focus, old men arguing in a dark council hall, mouths open, hands up. Adult proportions on the blurred men, the hand a real boy's hand, never chibi. No readable text. DEPTH: the brush tip razor-sharp, the hall a wash of warm dark.

at: The High Councillor comes to see the king that afternoon.
alt: The High Councillor stands in the king’s room and will not sit, complimenting the garden.
scene: WIDE, low three-quarter: the king's room open to a garden in hard afternoon light. An old man, the High Councillor, standing very straight and refusing the cushion, one hand on his cane, looking out at the garden as he compliments it. The young king seated, watching him, not the garden. A great deal of empty floor. Adult proportions, never chibi. One hard sun key from the garden door. DEPTH: the cushion sharp and unused in the foreground, the two men sharp, the garden in bright haze.
